mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Teams = xG league table with expected points and team stats. Players = xG, xA, xGOT, per-90 and defensive stats per player. Matches = xG and stats for every finished match.

leagues.title: Leagues
leagues.description: Premier League, Championship, League One, LaLiga, LaLiga2, Serie A, Bundesliga, Ligue 1, Eredivisie, Liga Portugal, Scottish Premiership, Belgian Pro League, Super Lig, MLS, Brasileirao, Liga MX, Saudi Pro League, J League, A-League, Champions League, Europa League, Conference League, World Cup... or any FotMob league ID or URL.

season.title: Season
season.description: e.g. 2025/2026 (or 2025 for MLS and Brazil). Empty = current season. xG goes back to about 2017 for top leagues.

lastMatches.title: Last N matches per league
lastMatches.description: Matches mode: only the most recent N finished matches per league. 0 = the whole season so far.

includeShots.title: Shot map
includeShots.description: Matches mode: add every shot with minute, player, result, xG, xGOT, situation, shot type and pitch position.

minMinutes.title: Min minutes played
minMinutes.description: Players mode: skip players with fewer minutes.

maxRows.title: Max rows
maxRows.description: Cap on rows returned. Controls cost.
